scope: Fixed-identity material-transport interpretation, conditional source budgets, and a finite supply/exchange/exhaustion control. Not a full life, physical thermodynamics or biological capability witness.
core_results: Derive gross input/output from fixed-token relocation rather than free positive counts.
Simultaneous body, source and system/exterior balance; cumulative intake bounded by stock plus explicit supply and recycling.
Same-clock realization of an explicit source world using the old six-axiom body; zero future intake after source exhaustion in normal and cut branches.

interpretation_conditions.carrier: A fixed finite set of material identities with unit-count ownership at one location per state.
interpretation_conditions.status: Explicit carrier interpretation / model-interface conditions, not new general physical axioms or empirically validated constitutive laws.

source_budget: final_stock + cumulative_intake + cumulative_source_export = initial_stock + cumulative_exterior_supply + cumulative_recycling
no_refill_consequence: Without external refill or recycling, cumulative material intake is bounded by initial accessible stock. No mortality/free-energy claim follows from finite matter alone.

phases: Exterior token enters source with no intake.
Source token enters body while previous body token enters sink.
control.protocol_scope: Registered natural sensing protocol. Changed sensing/resource/recycling protocols require their own realization checks.

process_contract: Existing Interaction.TimedRefinement preserves joint event/next-state laws for every admitted source state and input, with the same world clock. Body count and supported transfer counts must match the declared medium ledger.

checks: Physical initial projection equals original body init and source-world start.
Outgoing transported count matches the original ledger, as well as the incoming count used by the definition.

remaining_obligations: Empirical/implementation grounding of material identities and accessible-source/return-sink ports.
Resource-consequential feedback and matched intervention certificates.

certificates.name: CGB.MaterialSource.balance
certificates.signature:
∀ {C : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype C] (before after : C → CGB.MaterialSource.Place),
  CGB.MaterialSource.Allowed before after →
    CGB.MaterialSource.count after CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body +
          CGB.MaterialSource.moved before after CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body CGB.MaterialSource.Place.sink =
        CGB.MaterialSource.count before CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body +
          CGB.MaterialSource.moved before after CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body ∧
      CGB.MaterialSource.count after CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
              CGB.MaterialSource.moved before after CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body +
            CGB.MaterialSource.moved before after CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside =
          CGB.MaterialSource.count before CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
              CGB.MaterialSource.moved before after CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
            CGB.MaterialSource.moved before after CGB.MaterialSource.Place.sink CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source ∧
        CGB.MaterialSource.count after CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body +
                  CGB.MaterialSource.count after CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
                CGB.MaterialSource.count after CGB.MaterialSource.Place.sink +
              CGB.MaterialSource.moved before after CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside +
            CGB.MaterialSource.moved before after CGB.MaterialSource.Place.sink CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside =
          CGB.MaterialSource.count before CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body +
                CGB.MaterialSource.count before CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
              CGB.MaterialSource.count before CGB.MaterialSource.Place.sink +
            CGB.MaterialSource.moved before after CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source

certificates.name: CGB.MaterialSource.intake_bound_without_refill
certificates.signature:
∀ {C : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype C] (path : ℕ → C → CGB.MaterialSource.Place),
  (∀ (t : ℕ), CGB.MaterialSource.Allowed (path t) (path (t + 1))) →
    (∀ (t : ℕ),
        CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path t) (path (t + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside
              CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
            CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path t) (path (t + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.sink
              CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source =
          0) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ),
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n,
            CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path t) (path (t + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source
              CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body ≤
          CGB.MaterialSource.count (path 0) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source

certificates.name: CGB.MaterialSource.moved_le_stock
certificates.signature:
∀ {C : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype C] (before after : C → CGB.MaterialSource.Place) (p q : CGB.MaterialSource.Place),
  CGB.MaterialSource.moved before after p q ≤ CGB.MaterialSource.count before p

certificates.name: CGB.MaterialSource.no_intake_from_empty_source
certificates.signature:
∀ {C : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype C] (before after : C → CGB.MaterialSource.Place),
  CGB.MaterialSource.count before CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source = 0 →
    CGB.MaterialSource.moved before after CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body = 0

certificates.name: CGB.MaterialSource.no_transport_without_relocation
certificates.signature:
∀ {C : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype C] (owner : C → CGB.MaterialSource.Place),
  CGB.MaterialSource.moved owner owner CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body = 0 ∧
    CGB.MaterialSource.moved owner owner CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body CGB.MaterialSource.Place.sink = 0

certificates.name: CGB.MaterialSource.source_budget
certificates.signature:
∀ {C : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype C] (path : ℕ → C → CGB.MaterialSource.Place),
  (∀ (t : ℕ), CGB.MaterialSource.Allowed (path t) (path (t + 1))) →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      CGB.MaterialSource.count (path n) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
          ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n,
            (CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path t) (path (t + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source
                CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body +
              CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path t) (path (t + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source
                CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside) =
        CGB.MaterialSource.count (path 0) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
          ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n,
            (CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path t) (path (t + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside
                CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
              CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path t) (path (t + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.sink
                CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source)

certificates.name: CGB.MaterialSourceControls.no_future_intake_after_exhaustion
certificates.signature:
∀ (cut : Bool) (history : List (Option Unit)) (k : ℕ),
  (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.coarse cut).firstHit List.length Option.isSome history k
      (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.project 2) =
    0

certificates.name: CGB.MaterialSourceControls.realized
certificates.signature:
∀ (cut : Bool),
  CGB.MaterialSource.Realization CGB.MaterialSourceControls.physical (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.coarse cut)
    CGB.MaterialSourceControls.owner CGB.MaterialSourceControls.project (fun z => CGB.TurnoverControls.body.total z.1)
    CGB.MaterialSourceControls.declared CGB.MaterialSourceControls.declared CGB.MaterialSourceControls.world.clock

certificates.name: CGB.MaterialSourceControls.supply_exchange_exhaustion
certificates.signature:
CGB.MaterialSource.moved (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.owner 0) (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.owner 1)
      CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source =
    1 ∧
  CGB.MaterialSource.moved (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.owner 0) (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.owner 1)
        CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body =
      0 ∧
    CGB.MaterialSource.moved (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.owner 1) (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.owner 2)
          CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body =
        1 ∧
      CGB.MaterialSource.moved (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.owner 1) (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.owner 2)
            CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body CGB.MaterialSource.Place.sink =
          1 ∧
        CGB.MaterialSource.count (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.owner 2) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source = 0 ∧
          ∀ (p : CGB.MaterialSourceControls.Phase),
            CGB.MaterialSource.count (CGB.MaterialSourceControls.owner p) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body = 1
